s.zh: 稀有档和神器档植入物占调谐位。
s.en: Rare and artifact tier implants take attunement slots.

s.zh: 职业强度（悬停看分项来源）
1.136.0：DND 职业能力、法术、秘传、湖印可以对任何小人施放（殖民者、访客、中立、囚犯、奴隶、动物、机械体）：伤害 / 控制类可以打自己人，治疗 / 增益可以给敌人。范围效果里其他人照旧按敌我分；纯自身、地面、尸体、建筑类目标不变。NPC 和自动施放仍按原来的规则挑目标。
s.en: 1.136.0: DND class abilities, spells, arcana and lake seals can be cast on any pawn (colonists, visitors, neutrals, prisoners, slaves, animals, mechanoids): damage / control can hit your own people, and heals / buffs can go to enemies. Other people in area effects are still sorted by friend or foe; pure self, ground, corpse and building targets are unchanged. NPCs and autocast still pick targets by the old rules.

s.zh: 1.136.0：殖民者头像下面画一条细资源条，显示主资源（等级最高、有资源的职业：法力 / 斗志 / 神恩 / 气 / 乐韵 / 契约法力 / 怒气；没有就显示法术能量或湖息）。
s.en: 1.136.0: draws a thin resource bar under colonist portraits, showing the main resource (the highest-level class with a resource: mana / fighting spirit / divine favor / ki / rhythm / pact mana / rage; otherwise spell energy or lake breath).
